bot.name: Steamhammer
bot.description: An all-race bot with varied openings, adaptive production, and persistent opponent and game-state learning. Human difficulty is not yet calibrated.

formats.notes: Local 1v1 and concurrent x86/x64 SC:R smoke tests on Fighting Spirit; exact race and format coverage is recorded in the admission review.
The tested three-player melee stalled Zerg production. This build assumes one opponent; use 1v1.

mapConstraints: Legacy SC:R unit limits required by the experimental bridge.

learning.notes: Opponent opening history and race-matchup evaluator persist in private working copies. Reset learning restores an empty baseline.

license.name: MIT
license.notes: Separate original notices cover UAlbertaBot, FAP, RapidJSON and msinttypes; linked BWAPI is LGPLv3.

localDistribution.evidence: Reviewed pinned source, component notices, modified-source archive and offline rebuild. https://github.com/ShieldBattery/robotics-facility/blob/steamhammer-sb-1/docs/steamhammer-admission.md

publicCompetition.evidence: Track separately from local distribution; author outreach planned by Travis.

limitations: Requires ShieldBattery BWAPI bridge with frame-zero delivery and mineral type normalization (652c1d07f or later).
Fighting Spirit smoke tests cover all three races across x86/x64 SC:R; broader maps and late-game strategies remain unverified.
FFA is unsupported after a Zerg production stall in the three-player test; teams remain unverified.
The bridge does not implement stock BWAPI latency compensation.
Human difficulty has not been calibrated.

sourceReview.evidence: Reviewed source effects, isolated storage, exact package, offline rebuild and x86/x64 gameplay; not an OS sandbox certification. https://github.com/ShieldBattery/robotics-facility/blob/steamhammer-sb-1/docs/steamhammer-admission.md
